name: OpenRAE SDL
comment: SDL source is YAML (sdl-yaml/v1). This grammar delegates all YAML tokenization to VS Code's built-in source.yaml grammar and injects two SDL-specific token kinds: top-level SDL keys and ${variable} placeholders. Top-level key names mirror the properties of contracts/schemas/sdl/sdl-authoring-input-v1.json; test/grammar.test.mjs fails if they drift from the bundled schema.

section-key.comment: Authoring section at column 0 of a block mapping key.
section-key.name: support.type.section.openrae-sdl

metadata-key.comment: Document metadata and composition keys at column 0.
metadata-key.name: support.type.metadata.openrae-sdl

placeholder.comment: Variable reference such as ${replicas}; names follow the variables section key pattern.
placeholder.name: variable.other.placeholder.openrae-sdl
